skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of Marxist-Leninist philosophy and its role in social life and modern reforms.
Develop logical, scientific thinking and analytical skills to understand complex social issues.
Promote global citizenship and responsible social action.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to analyze and solve philosophical and social issues.
Conduct independent and group research, and present findings effectively.
Understand the core concepts of dialectical materialism and historical materialism.
Grasp the concept of matter, its forms of existence, and the relationship between matter and consciousness.
Understand the principles and laws of dialectical materialism.
Understand the theory of knowledge in dialectical materialism and the role of practice in cognition.
Understand the theory of social forms and the role of class struggle in social development.
